# zig-clap (vendored)

Command-line argument parser for Zig, by Jimmi Holst Christensen (MIT, see `LICENSE`).
Upstream: https://github.com/Hejsil/zig-clap, version 0.12.0 (`minimum_zig_version`
0.17.0-dev), commit `05faf3905e8548f5cc269a8836e154065e70128d`.

Only `clap.zig` and `clap/` are kept. zpawn imports it as module `clap` (see
`build.zig`). **No local patch.**
